# Slim Framework v4.15.3 Multi-Portal Documentation Suite (Unofficial Drawlib Showcase)

> Unofficial community documentation, PSR-7/15/11 API catalog, internal architecture walkthrough, and software diagnostic report of Slim Framework v4.15.3 (`https://slim.drawlib.com/`).
> Official Slim Framework documentation: https://www.slimframework.com/

## Portals

- [Slim 4 User Guide (EN/JA)](https://slim.drawlib.com/user_guide/): Practical developer guide, enterprise PSR-7 / PSR-15 / PSR-11 patterns, PHP-DI auto-wiring, FastRoute groups & caching, JWT/RBAC security, and PHPUnit/worker operations (`https://slim.drawlib.com/user_guide/llms.txt`).
- [Slim 4 API Reference Catalog (EN/JA)](https://slim.drawlib.com/api/): Searchable symbol catalog covering `Slim\App`, `Slim\Factory\*`, `Slim\Routing\*`, `Slim\Middleware\*`, `Slim\Handlers\*`, `Slim\Error\Renderers\*`, `Slim\Exception\*`, and `Slim\Interfaces\*` (`https://slim.drawlib.com/api/llms.txt`).
- [Slim 4 Internal Architecture Guide (EN/JA)](https://slim.drawlib.com/architecture/): Source-level walkthrough of Slim v4.15.3 internals (`https://slim.drawlib.com/architecture/llms.txt`).
- [PNI501 Diagnostic Report (HTML & PDF)](https://slim.drawlib.com/pni501/): Deterministic 15-stage PHP AST, namespace dependency DAG, hermetic PHPUnit + PCOV runtime, and supply-chain audit (`https://slim.drawlib.com/pni501/pni501.pdf`, `https://slim.drawlib.com/pni501/llms.txt`).
